- The weapon these characters wear has changed by itself into the new kind, of the same rarity, level and upgrade, with the same affixes. Rings and armour still work.
- Every character got a Scroll of Oblivion: in Stats it resets the points you have given out, so you give them out anew, for free.

0.3.65.title: Version 0.3.65
0.3.65.body:
- Every evolution brings a Scroll of Oblivion from the System: the first, the second and the third, and a change of evolution at Sambor's too. The free reset right after the first evolution stays and does not use up the scroll.
- Sambor sells a Scroll of Oblivion instead of resetting your stats, for the same gold as before. He sells one when you have none.
- After a change of evolution at Sambor's, your weapon and off-hand change by themselves into the new form's weapons, so your character is never left without a weapon.

0.3.66.title: Version 0.3.66
0.3.66.body: - The Necromancer, the Lich, the Grand Inquisitor and the Demon Slayer see in the Bag, on the Marketplace, in a Trade and in the Storeroom what they can wear. Staves and foci, and swords and axes for the Inquisitors, are theirs. Daggers and aspergilla say their class cannot use them. Before, the page went by the class from before the evolution.

0.3.67.title: Version 0.3.67
0.3.67.body:
- Item cards say who wears them, evolutions included. A staff says “Classes: Mage, Necromancer, Lich”, and a dagger “Class: Shadow” and “Not for: Necromancer, Lich”. The same in the Encyclopedia.
- The Workshop first offers a pattern of the weapon your evolution wears, e.g. a staff for a Necromancer.

0.3.68.title: Version 0.3.68
0.3.68.body:
- The Necromancer and the Lich wear the Mage's armour too: hoods and robes. The Grand Inquisitor and the Demon Slayer wear the Warrior's helmets and chainmail, and a shield in the off-hand. The armour and focus they wear have changed by themselves into the new kind, with the same rarity, level, upgrade and affixes.
- The male Sharpshooter has a new face on his portrait, with eyes.

0.3.69.title: Version 0.3.69
0.3.69.body:
- Time in the game gives Time Points: every minute with the game on the screen is 1 Time Point, up to 60 a day. Just watching counts too, and after 10 minutes without a touch the count waits for the next one.
- Today's count is in the wallet under the gold, by the Time Points: “For time in the game: 23 of 60 today”.

0.3.70.title: Version 0.3.70
0.3.70.body:
- The Arena and guild wars: the second forms are evened out. The Grand Inquisitor, the Druid and the Phantom strike harder, the Thunder Lord and the Huntmaster softer, and the Bastion has less HP, in players' duels only. Before, at level 100 the Grand Inquisitor won 1% of its duels and the Druid 9%. Now every second form wins from 31% to 70%.
- Explorations, towers, the Labyrinth and fights with creatures do not change.

0.3.72.title: Version 0.3.72
0.3.72.body: - Skin tones on portraits: on 71 portraits of forms, outfits and starting classes, part of the skin did not change colour with the chosen tone. On dark skin, for example, a light strip of forehead or a light edge of a hand stayed. Now all the skin has the chosen tone, and hair, armour and outfits stay as they were.

0.3.73.title: Version 0.3.73
0.3.73.body:
- Guild wars are now a league: every guild plays every other, whatever its number of members. Every evening at 20:00 your guild plays a match against the next guild until it has played them all, and with an odd number of guilds one has each evening off. The wars drawn on Sunday night were reset, and this week's league starts with the next evening.
- A match is 1v1 and 3v3 fights: every member of the guild fights every member of the rival guild, and every trio fights every rival trio. The game draws the trios before every evening, and a trio short of members loses its fights by walkover.
- The War tab has the league table with the balance of fights over the whole week. On Sunday 1st place collects 100 Fame points and a war chest of 3 champion items, 2nd place 60 Fame points and a champion item, and 3rd place 30 Fame points.
- For every fight you win you collect gold, and for a won match you fought in, 2 System Points.
- One in ten cards from explorations, the Labyrinth, profession work and the Guild comes as a pack of three cards, like Szczęsny's. You open it for free in the Games Parlour, on the Cards tab.
- At Szczęsny's, after the day's pack you can buy a second one the same day for 3 times the price.
- On the Combat screen, the rest box shows your wounded companions: they will not go with you on an exploration until you rest to full HP.
- On a computer, the hint by the Time Points no longer flickers under the mouse.

0.3.74.title: Version 0.3.74
0.3.74.body:
- The guild has a notice board: at the top of the Guild tab the leader and the deputies post announcements for all members. A new announcement lights a dot by the tab.
- The leader and the deputies have their own chat channel, “Command”, which the guild's members do not see.

0.3.75.title: Version 0.3.75
0.3.75.body:
- A party has its own chat: while you are in a party, the chat has a “Party” tab that only its members read and write in.
- When building a deck you can sort the cards: by type, rarity, level, attack, life or name.
- Effect cards can be chosen right under “All”, above the creature cards, without switching the filter.

0.3.76.title: Version 0.3.76
0.3.76.body: - The Account Chest takes minerals and shows their proper icons.

0.3.77.title: Version 0.3.77
0.3.77.body: - In the Account Chest you can sort what you put in: the items of your bag as in the Bag, and the goods by order, amount or name.

0.3.79.title: Version 0.3.79
0.3.79.body: - Scrolls are goods like the others: you can put the Ward Scroll, the Steady Scroll and the Scroll of Oblivion up at the Marketplace (a new “Scrolls” tab), give them in a Trade, put them in the Account Chest and ask your guild for them.

0.3.80.title: Version 0.3.80
0.3.80.body: - In the exploration scene with a party, the whole line, mounts and pets included, now fits in the frame. The leader's pet no longer disappears past the edge.

0.3.81.title: Version 0.3.81
0.3.81.body:
- Three new professions from character level 25: Fishing, Farming and Cooking.
- Fishing: at the System Pond you catch fish, from the roach to the golden fish, and with each level more kinds at once.
- Farming: on the System Field you sow the plots, each with a different crop, and watch the plants grow. With each level you get more plots and new crops.
- Cooking: in the System Kitchen you cook dishes of fish, crops and herbs. You choose a dish in the exploration's options, and its bonuses work for 4 hours of explorations: more XP, gold, materials, resources, cards, chests or rarer items. Better dishes join several bonuses.
- Fish, crops and dishes go to the Pantry, a new tab of the Bag. They take no room in it, and Zbylut the innkeeper buys them.
- The Account Chest now holds as many items as your bag.

0.3.82.title: Version 0.3.82
0.3.82.body:
- Claiming the report of any profession now starts a mini-game: tap while the marker is in the green zone. You get three tries, and the zone gets narrower with each.
- Hits give +5%, +10% or +20% of what the work brings, and in the System Workshop and the Gem Workshop a better chance of an item a rarity higher.
- You can skip the mini-game and take the usual result.

0.3.83.title: Version 0.3.83
0.3.83.body: - Fix: the System Avatar's work report can be claimed after the mini-game again. The work waited untouched, so nothing was lost.

0.3.84.title: Version 0.3.84
0.3.84.body: - Fix: the top bar on a phone no longer twitches while a build's time counts down under the Camp's tent.

0.3.85.title: Version 0.3.85
0.3.85.body: - The Professions tab also counts down the System Avatar's work while your character itself is not working in a profession: on a phone in the bottom bar, on a computer in the menu on the left.

0.3.86.title: Version 0.3.86
0.3.86.body:
- Guild ranks: R4 the leader, R3 deputies, R2 members and R1 novices. The rank badge stands by the name in the members' list.
- A character new to a guild is a novice for its first 3 days: from the Guild Chest it takes only the items left for it. The leader and the deputies can promote it sooner with "Make member".
- Members already in guilds are R2 right away.

0.3.87.title: Version 0.3.87
0.3.87.body:
- Professions grow 3 times faster: a level takes 10 minutes of work times the level instead of 30. Levels you have stay, and the progress bar stands where it stood.
- The System Avatar now gives all the profession progress from its work (character experience still a quarter). Your character goes on explorations while the Avatar levels a profession as fast as the character would.

0.3.88.title: Version 0.3.88
0.3.88.body:
- The mini-game at a profession's report counts a tap the moment you touch the button, not when you lift your finger, so the marker stops exactly where you see it.
- After the last try, "Claim report" claims it with the first tap.

0.3.89.title: Version 0.3.89
0.3.89.body:
- Beside your character's strip there is a short "AVATAR" strip with the System Avatar's work time. When the Avatar's report waits, the strip shows "REPORT". A tap leads to its profession.
- On a narrow phone with a potion at work, the potion's tile shows only the number of fights, so everything fits in one row.
- The quest "Complete orders in the Settlement" comes only when the Order Board can fill it. If you have such a quest today that can no longer be done before midnight, the game swaps it for another, and you keep your reroll.
- On a computer and a tablet the bag's tabs stand in two rows and no longer spill out of their frames.

0.3.90.title: Version 0.3.90
0.3.90.body: - You can also put crafting parts from the Salvage Table (scraps, straps, crystal splinters and more) into the Account Chest. They are on the "Goods" tab, between materials and minerals.

0.3.91.title: Version 0.3.91
0.3.91.body: - You reroll the narrator's quests one by one: a die stands beside every quest not done yet. You can reroll each quest once, and the others keep their progress.

0.3.92.title: Version 0.3.92
0.3.92.body:
- The time counters in the top bar, the tabs and the screens no longer twitch every second, also with bold text on the phone.
- A skill's name over a character in a fight no longer gets cut at the right edge on a narrow phone.

0.3.93.title: Version 0.3.93
0.3.93.body:
- Tier IX of the items: 22 new items from class level 175, one in each family, named after Polish legends and Slavic gods (Szczerbiec, Perun's Axe, the Shield of Achilles, the Golden Horn and more). They drop from the Wild Den (lvl 171–175), and their crafting patterns open at profession level 175.
- The Encyclopedia has a Tier IX with its own chest, and the materials of creatures above level 200 stand in Tier IX.
- The mini-game at a profession's report: after each tap the marker stops for a moment. A hit glows green, a miss red, each with its own sound. On Android the phone gives a short buzz.

0.3.94.title: Version 0.3.94
0.3.94.body: - A build's countdown over a building on the Camp's map fits on one line again instead of breaking into several.

0.3.95.title: Version 0.3.95
0.3.95.body:
- The Arena from level 200 up is evened out: in players' duels the Archdruid, the Demon Slayer, the Saint, the Bowmaster, the Godslayer and the Shadow Lord hit harder, and the Ruler of the Wilds less hard. From level 200 duels also have more HP, so they last a few rounds.
- When you open a card pack, the glow of the rarest card no longer reaches the edge of the screen on a narrow phone.

0.3.96.title: Version 0.3.96
0.3.96.body: - The game is lighter on the server: the Character tab, the count of players online and other often refreshed places read much less from the database, which will help as more players come.

0.3.97.title: Version 0.3.97
0.3.97.body: - Over the characters at the top of the Character tab there are now two times: the character's work and, under it, its Avatar's work (“A”).

0.3.98.title: Version 0.3.98
0.3.98.body:
- Guild war league: characters of one account in both guilds now fight on both sides, against each other too. Till now they did not fight at all, and their trios lost by walkover.
- The characters' names show under the portraits in the trios and the reserve.

0.4.0.title: Version 0.4.0
0.4.0.body:
- Guild war league: Monday's evening of the league will be fought again, today at 23:00 (Polish time). The fights from 20:00 are gone, and their gold and System Points go back to what they were before them. The trios and the fights are drawn anew, with the characters of one account on both sides.
- Under each match in “The evenings' results” there is an “All fights” button: every fight of the match, not only yours, grouped by your guild’s trios and members. You can watch any of them.
- The War tab loads faster.

0.4.1.title: Version 0.4.1
0.4.1.body: - Guild war league: the game draws the trios for the evening once, at midnight, and they stay for the whole day. One who joins the guild during the day fights only the 1v1 that evening, and one who leaves leaves an empty place in the trio. The trios for today's rerun at 23:00 are already set.

0.4.2.title: Version 0.4.2
0.4.2.body:
- Reward for days in a row: at your first visit of the day you take that day's reward. Each next day gives more gold and Time Points, and day 7 brings a pack of cards and 5 System Points. A missed day starts the series anew. One series per account.
- Guild war league: “How does it work?” now says more exactly how free evenings work and that with more than 8 guilds some evenings have two matches.

0.4.3.title: Version 0.4.3
0.4.3.body:
- “Tutorials” in the Settings: the narrator's explanations to read and listen to at any time. Under many parts there is “Explain again”: the narrator goes through them with you from the start.
- “Additional parameters” in the Stats show what the Core adds.

0.4.4.title: Version 0.4.4
0.4.4.body: - Reward for days in a row: each character now has its own series and its own reward of the day.

0.4.5.title: Version 0.4.5
0.4.5.body: - Guild war league, 3v3: every trio fights every trio of the rival, a short one too, with fewer members. The guild with fewer trios gives one fight by walkover for each trio it lacks. For example: 18 members make 6 trios and 29 members make 10, so there are 60 trio fights and the smaller guild gives 4 by walkover. Today's rerun at 23:00 already fights this way.

0.4.6.title: Version 0.4.6
0.4.6.body:
- Guild war league, 3v3: there are as many fights as if both guilds had the trios of the bigger one. Each trio the smaller guild lacks loses by walkover to every rival trio. For example, 6 trios against 10 make 100 fights, and the smaller guild gives 40 of them by walkover. The rule works from the evening of 17 November.
- Day series: a thin tab with a calendar at the left edge of the screen shows the day of your series. Gold means the reward of the day is waiting. Tap it to see your progress.
- Achievements: on the Character tab, under the portrait, there is an “Achievements” button. 24 goals in 9 groups wait there. Each gives a title and Time Points, and some System Points too. The reward comes to you when you look into the achievements window. You can wear a title you have earned: it shows in your profile and in the Ranking. Creatures, champions and wanted beaten, the gold of explorations, duels, league fights, Labyrinth runs and deals count from today.
- Familiar: Will-o'-the-Wisp now costs 600 System Points, like the other familiars. Those who bought it for 800 got 200 System Points back.
- Chat: hold a channel's tab, then slide it to a new place. The first channel opens when you enter the chat. The device remembers the order.

0.4.7.title: Version 0.4.7
0.4.7.body: - Generous Feast: from 1 to 24 December each character can take one reward a day for coming into the game: gold, Time Points and System Points, card packs, potions, scrolls and Camp decorations. On the 24th the winter set waits: the Hoarfrost frame, the Generous Feast background and the Snowstorm aura, which cannot be bought. The calendar opens on 1 December, and a day missed is lost.

0.4.8.title: Version 0.4.8
0.4.8.body: - Generous Feast: all December long, the narrator's quests have a Winter tab with three quests every day: fir branches from explorations, a carp for Christmas Eve and a dish from the System Kitchen. Each gives Time Points and gold, and all three in one day give a card pack.

0.4.9.title: Version 0.4.9
0.4.9.body: - Generous Feast: the narrator has new lines for December. He will welcome you at the start of the Feast, tell you about the winter quests and speak again on Christmas Eve.

0.4.10.title: Version 0.4.10
0.4.10.body: - Skills now cost half their old mana and 3% of your max mana, but never less than before. With a big mana pool skills are no longer almost free. The Skills tab shows what each skill costs your character.

0.4.11.title: Version 0.4.11
0.4.11.body: - The System Portals now go up to stage 500 instead of 100. As before, you fight for stages up to your character's level, and the higher the stage, the bigger the loot.

0.4.12.title: Version 0.4.12
0.4.12.body: - Generous Feast: in December snow will cover the Camp, coloured lights will shine over the campfire, and the decorations taken from the calendar will stand by the fire.

0.4.13.title: Version 0.4.13
0.4.13.body:
- The daily quest “Complete orders in the Settlement” now comes, also after a reroll, only when the orders already wait on the Order Board. Orders that come later and the big order of the week don't count.
- The Enchantress's hints (“★” and “Worth enchanting”) and the bag's verdicts on items (“better”, “worse”) now follow your evolution's stats. When an evolution counts one stat as another, such as the Necromancer's Dexterity as Intellect, both count the same. This affects the lines of the Storm Archer, the Hunter, the Grand Inquisitor and the Necromancer.
- The guild war chest now gives items for the fighters' evolutions, such as staves instead of daggers for a Necromancer.

0.4.16.title: Version 0.4.16
0.4.16.body: - In the guild’s Exchange one offer can now hold up to 100,000 pieces of a resource on each side, instead of up to 1,000.

0.4.17.title: Version 0.4.17
0.4.17.body: - The Marketplace’s “Sort:” has a new option, “Newest”: the most recently listed offers first.

0.4.18.title: Version 0.4.18
0.4.18.body: - On the Character tab an item with a gem set in it shows that gem in the top corner of its tile, as in Jewelcrafting’s Setting.

0.4.19.title: Version 0.4.19
0.4.19.body:
- The Marketplace’s log shows auctions lost too: your last bid, the winning price and who won. Such lines are written from this version on.
- At the Enchantress you can also imbue an element with parts: 20 Crystal Splinters or 2 Amber instead of the element’s material, for the same gold.

0.4.20.title: Version 0.4.20
0.4.20.body: - On the reindeer the reins run from the mouth to every rider’s hands. Riders who hold reins of their own, such as the Saint, the Prophetess or the Winter Lady, have them joined to the reindeer’s, no longer cut off in the air.

0.4.21.title: Version 0.4.21
0.4.21.body:
- Second System Avatar: once you have the Avatar, the Professions tab lets you buy a second one for 200,000 gold. It works at the same time as your character and the first Avatar, just as efficiently and for the same rewards. When you start a job, choose Character, Avatar or Second Avatar.
- When both Avatars are working, the top bar shows one “AVATARS” strip. Tap it to unfold a tab for each with the time left.

0.4.23.title: Version 0.4.23
0.4.23.body:
- The Bestiary shows the weak point and resistances of the creatures your character has fought, e.g. “Weak point: sacred +50%” and “Resistance: fire −32%”. It makes it easier to choose which element to enchant your weapon with before an expedition.
- The resistance percent is counted at your character's level, just as in combat.

0.4.24.title: Version 0.4.24
0.4.24.body:
- In December the System Shop's Outfits tab will have winter outfits for every class: Generous Feast Armour, Winter Archer's Garb, Frost Mage's Furs, Star-Bearer's Robes and Winter Night Cloak. Each costs 800 System Points and works with every evolution: on the portrait, on the march and in the saddle. On sale only in December.
- When your character rides a pony, the companions walking beside it are now bigger and fit the rider better.

0.4.25.title: Version 0.4.25
0.4.25.body: - The guild's member list now shows when each member was last in the game, as in Friends: “now”, “3 h ago”, “yesterday” or “12 days ago”.

0.4.26.title: Version 0.4.26
0.4.26.body:
- Tier X items: 22 new items from class level 200, one in every family, among them the Grunwald Sword, Jutrzenka's Bow, Veles's Staff, Mieszko's Helmet and Jadwiga's Crown. They drop on explorations from the last place of the Ostępy Nowiu (level 196–200), and for characters whose class is at level 200 the weekly chest, the trader, the Game Parlour, the Towers, the Beast, the Guild Expedition and the guild war give them too. The Encyclopedia shows them already.
- St Andrew's Eve: on 29 November from 18:00 a Fortune Evening waits on the Fight screen. You pour wax through the eye of an old key, and the shape it sets into is your omen. On 30 November, all day, you pick one of three cups, and a wax figurine lies under it. Each omen gives a bonus for a day, e.g. more XP or gold from fights, and a small gift at once. For fortunes on both evenings you get the portrait background “St Andrew's Eve” and the achievement “St Andrew's Fortune” with the title Fortune Teller.

0.4.27.title: Version 0.4.27
0.4.27.body: - In an evolution's description the skills' heading now says “at the top level” instead of a level's number. The numbers there were always those of the skills' top level, and the number misled.

0.4.28.title: Version 0.4.28
0.4.28.body: - The evening of the three cups on St Andrew's Eve (30 November) has a new picture: three covered cups, and after your choice a wax figurine stands where the cup was.

0.4.29.title: Version 0.4.29
0.4.29.body: - The Healer (man) has a corrected face on his portrait, in every skin tone.

0.4.30.title: Version 0.4.30
0.4.30.body: - Your pet now shows above the character frame: the frame no longer hides it.

0.4.31.title: Version 0.4.31
0.4.31.body:
- In a party, your companions from the Quarters skip only the party's explorations. They go with you on your own explorations, into the Labyrinth and the Portals as always, so there is no need to leave the party.
- A leader who unticks “With the party” sets out with their own companions.

0.4.32.title: Version 0.4.32
0.4.32.body:
- A party leader chooses above “Set out”: “With the party” or “With companions”. A party member sees which companions will go with them on their own exploration.
- The chat has an “Administration” tab for the administration and the moderators.

0.4.33.title: Version 0.4.33
0.4.33.body:
- You can now put fish, crops and dishes up on the Marketplace, in the new “Pantry” tab, and trade them with another player in the Exchange.
- A game left open on the chat reloads to a new version by itself while you are not typing.

0.4.34.title: Version 0.4.34
0.4.34.body: - In the Guild Requests you can also ask for fish, crops and dishes, and your guild mates give them from their Pantry.

0.4.35.title: Version 0.4.35
0.4.35.body: - You can also put fish, crops and dishes in the Guild Chest: “Put in from the Pantry”, for everyone or for one guild member.

0.4.36.title: Version 0.4.36
0.4.36.body:
- In the Guild Exchange you can also trade fish, crops and dishes: for resources, for gold or for other goods from the Pantry.
- When putting something up on the Marketplace, tap a herb, potion, material, mineral, scroll or Pantry good to see its full description.

0.4.37.title: Version 0.4.37
0.4.37.body: - All over the Marketplace, tapping a good unfolds its full description: in players' offers, in your offers, in “To collect” and in the Register.

0.4.38.title: Version 0.4.38
0.4.38.body: - A good's card on the Marketplace first says what it gives: a dish its meal, a gem its bonus once set, and a herb, fish or crop which potions and dishes it goes into.

0.4.39.title: Version 0.4.39
0.4.39.body:
- Generous Feast (1–24 December): the winter set (the Hoarfrost frame, the Generous Feast background and the Snowstorm aura) comes in the 24th window only if you took all 24 windows.
- From 12 to 24 December you can also buy each piece of the set for System Points, only in the calendar's window.

0.4.40.title: Version 0.4.40
0.4.40.body:
- Every guild member now gets a Beast Chest, even without attacking. It counts everyone who was in the guild when the beast came or joined before it fell. This also applies to this week's and last week's beasts.
- New beasts have twice as much HP. The beasts already standing this week stay as they are.
- A heal of the whole party no longer shows "+0" on characters at full HP.

0.4.41.title: Version 0.4.41
0.4.41.body: - New beasts have four times as much HP as before version 0.4.40, not twice. The beasts already standing this week stay as they are.

0.4.42.title: Version 0.4.42
0.4.42.body:
- You can now invite to a Party a character whose class level differs from yours by up to 10, not 5. Only the class level counts.
- Trading on the Marketplace now gives up to 30 reputation points with the Merchants' Company a day instead of 10.

0.4.43.title: Version 0.4.43
0.4.43.body: - In the Settings, below Discord, there are now buttons to the game's Facebook and TikTok and to the novel set in the game's world on Wattpad.

0.4.44.title: Version 0.4.44
0.4.44.body:
- From level 250 of the character and the class, a level needs much more experience: 3 times as much as before at level 250, and 10 times as much from level 300.
- The Encyclopedia's chests from Tier V give fewer Time Points: from 50 in Tier V to 100 in Tier X.

0.4.45.title: Version 0.4.45
0.4.45.body:
- The fourth evolution: at class level 300 each third form grows into its fourth, with new skills, looks, walk and riding.
- The narrator's line about the Party has its voice again.

0.4.46.title: Version 0.4.46
0.4.46.body:
- Levels 100 to 250 take longer and longer: level 100 as before, then longer with every level, up to almost 3 times as long as before just under level 250. Class levels too.
- From character level 250, explorations give half the gold, materials, resources and chests with items, and the other pursuits half the gold.
- Party: a party's trip now sets out whole or not at all. Before, a connection cut off while setting out could make a party member fight alone and lose while the leader won the same trip.
- One who turns back from a party's trip also leaves the others' march on the Combat screen.

0.4.47.title: Version 0.4.47
0.4.47.body:
- Nav, the land of the dead, awaits past the Bald Mountains, at levels 276–350: the Misty Marshes of Nav, the Meadows of Veles and the Sunless Land, 15 places and 51 new creatures with their own ways of fighting (stunning, silencing, trampling, vengeance and more).
- New materials, System Deck cards, Wanted posters and the “Explorer of Nav” achievement.

0.4.48.title: Version 0.4.48
0.4.48.body: - System Deck: once a match, before your first move, you can redraw your reserve. Your reserve cards go to the bottom of your deck and you draw new ones. It works at Szczęsny's, with the Settlement's residents, in the Arena and in live matches.

0.4.49.title: Version 0.4.49
0.4.49.body:
- Bald Mountains: the elites and champions (Griffin, Stone Giant, Cuckoo, Master Twardowski, Lady Death and Baba Yaga) are as hard again as when the Bald Mountains opened.
- Nav: the elites and champions evened out after the change of the level curve.
- Because of it, the System Deck cards of a few of these creatures have a slightly different Attack and Life; the Griffin, for example, hits harder but has less Life.

0.4.52.title: Version 0.4.52
0.4.52.body: - Full bag: the scrap dealer now sells the lowest rarity first. An item your class cannot use goes before the others only among items of the same rarity, so a valuable item of another class stays while you have anything weaker in the bag.

0.4.54.title: Version 0.4.54
0.4.54.body:
- Phone notifications now come for a private message in the chat: for the first message of a conversation.
- A tag in the Global, Trade or English chat no longer sends a notification. A tag in the guild chat still does.
- The chat no longer turns words like “pushujący” or “rushujemy” into stars.
- Navia: new pictures of the Stampede, the Dread, the Snow Flea Spring and Bayun's Whisker, and new sounds for the skills Arrow from Heaven, Rain of Stars, Pillar of Light and Legion of Navia.

0.4.55.title: Version 0.4.55
0.4.55.body:
- Kowadło: an “Order of items” row over the list: Equipped, Newest, Rarity, Level, Upgrade or Type. The phone remembers the choice.
- Bag: a “Mark for sale” button. Tap the items the scrap dealer should buy and sell them all at once. Favourites cannot be marked.

0.4.56.title: Version 0.4.56
0.4.56.body: - Party: before you set out alone as a party member, or switch characters (as the leader too), the game asks: “You are in a party. Leave the party?”. So a party no longer sets out without someone who got busy elsewhere.

0.4.57.title: Version 0.4.57
0.4.57.body: - From class level 250 the creatures are three times as strong: they hit harder and have more HP. In a party each extra player makes them 25% stronger still. This applies to explorations, the Towers, the Portals, the Labyrinth and the Wanted posters.

0.4.58.title: Version 0.4.58
0.4.58.body: - Hellish exploration: a new box in the exploration options, under the Hard exploration. The creatures deal 3× damage and have 3× HP, twice the Hard one. In return you get +50% XP, +125% gold and 1.5× as many items and materials. Not on quick or lightning hunts, nor with a party.

0.4.59.title: Version 0.4.59
0.4.59.body: - Party: switching characters or making a new one no longer asks anything, and the character stays in its party. The leader takes it on the party's explorations even while you play another character, and its report waits until you come back to it. The question “You are in a party. Leave the party?” now comes only before a party member sets out alone. A second character of the same player cannot join the party.

0.4.60.title: Version 0.4.60
0.4.60.body: - The difficulty threshold now counts by class level: from class level 250 the creatures are three times as strong wherever you fight, and in a party the highest class level among the players counts. From class level 250 you also get half the gold, materials, resources and chests.

0.4.61.title: Version 0.4.61
0.4.61.body:
- Labyrinth: after every fight, the level guardian's too, its report opens first. You can skip it with “Skip the report” or turn off the “Fight report at once” box under it. Only then come the blessing choice and the next level.
- Fix: the Labyrinth's windows with a fight's result, an altar and the merchant are no longer empty, also with Animations off.

0.4.62.title: Version 0.4.62
0.4.62.body: - The Hard and the Hellish exploration work with a party too. The leader ticks one in the “Exploration options” together with the “With the party” box, and the whole party goes in that mode. The creatures are stronger for everyone, and each player gets their own bonus: more XP and gold, and on the Hellish one more items and materials too.

0.4.63.title: Version 0.4.63
0.4.63.body:
- Stars at the Enchantress: from the standing “Trusted” she sets stars in items upgraded to +10. Up to five, each adding 10% of the item's value. The chance is small, but a failed try takes only the gold and the parts, and the item loses nothing.
- Your friends list now holds 50 people instead of 30.

0.4.64.title: Version 0.4.64
0.4.64.body: - From class level 100 the creatures grow a little stronger with every level, up to twice as strong just before level 250. In return your companions from class level 100 hit 1.4 times harder and have 1.4 times more HP.

0.4.65.title: Version 0.4.65
0.4.65.body:
- Portals: next to the stage fight there are ×5, ×10 and “Max” buttons. One tap fights the next stages until a defeat or your character's level, and one report shows the whole series and its loot.
- System Orbs: during an exploration a glowing orb now and then flies over the scene on the Combat screen. Catch it with a tap and you get gold, Time Points or a material. Up to 8 orbs a day.
- Deck cards now move between your characters through the Account Chest, go up on the Marketplace and into a Trade. A card from others raises its level, but it counts in the Encyclopedia, the collection bonus and achievements only once your character finds its own copy. Such a card keeps dropping until you find it.
- Long tabs get a “Back to top” button in the corner.

0.4.66.title: Version 0.4.66
0.4.66.body:
- Guild Chronicle: the System writes in your guild's chat about its big moments: the fall of the Beast and a guardian, a new Trials threshold and building level, a league evening, a new member and the Heroes of the week.
- Help with builds and work: on the Guild tab you can shorten other members' builds in the Camp and the Stronghold or their profession work. Each help cuts 1% of their time, and for each one you get a point of Fame for your guild, up to 20 a week.
- Classes of the day: every day two classes hit the Beast and the Expedition guardian 50% harder. The Beast's card shows which ones today.
- Strike and Hamstring: before an attack on the Beast or the guardian you choose Strike or Hamstring. A hamstring deals half damage, but the next three strikes by other members hit 60% harder. New Beasts and guardians have more HP for it.
- Rally horn: the leader or a deputy sets the hour of a rally. For that hour attacks on the Beast and the guardian hit 30% harder, and whoever misses it loses nothing.
- Heroes of the week: every Monday the System honours each guild's Guild Pillar, Slayer and Benefactor. For each honour you get 30 Time Points, a card pack and a badge by your name for the whole week.
- Lands under the banner: the guild that spends the most exploration minutes in a land during the week raises its banner there for the next week. For each banner the guild gets 30 Fame, and you get +5% gold and materials from creatures there for the week. The War tab shows the race.
- Temple: a temple now stands in the Guild Hall. Every week you vote for one of three gods, and the winner gives every member a bonus for the whole next week. Half the Trials then come from its domain.
- Guild Marks and the Stall: for every point of Fame you bring your guild you get a Guild Mark. Spend them in the Guild Stall on a card pack, a Ward Scroll, an item of your class, the title “Banner Warden” or the Banner Frame.

0.4.67.title: Version 0.4.67
0.4.67.body:
- The newest place for your level is dangerous again from level 30. A four-hour exploration there ends in a faint about one time in five, with companions and in a party. Shorter explorations are safer, and places a level or two lower are almost safe.
- In a party the creatures of the newest place grow with every extra player also below class level 250.
- “Threat” on the Combat screen now counts the whole exploration, including companions weakening and falling along the way, so it shows the real chance of fainting. Check it before you set out.

0.4.68.title: Version 0.4.68
0.4.68.body: - Gold in the Account Chest: you can now move gold between the characters of your account. “Put in” moves it from the character to the chest, and “Take out” from the chest to the character you play. No fees and no limits, from character level 20.
